rows.note: An .sslSocketFactory (trusting the private CA) whose layered socket is a delegating SSLSocket keeping SSLSocket's base getSSLParameters/setSSLParameters silently drops the reflective setEndpointIdentificationAlgorithm("HTTPS"). TlsConnector.endpointIdentification returns true merely because setSSLParameters did not throw, so on a non-Android JVM the HostnameVerifier is skipped and a backend whose certificate names other.example is reached for https://localhost (200, request bytes sent). Fix direction: after setSSLParameters, read back getSSLParameters().getEndpointIdentificationAlgorithm() by reflection and treat anything but "HTTPS" as not identified (falls to the verifier, which fails closed on the JDK).
